headline: Thunderstorms are slowing Newark, and the other hubs are running normally.

items.text: Thunderstorms, heavy rain and wind gusting to 32 knots are slowing arrivals and departures at Newark. Newark is the lowest of the seven United hubs reporting, with 78% of departures so far today leaving within 30 minutes of schedule (302 departed).
Washington Dulles has rain that can cause minor delays, and 82% of its departures so far today are on time (194 departed). The other hubs are running normally.

No FAA ground stop or ground delay program is in effect at a United hub, but the FAA has a ground stop for flights into Boston until 9:30 PM ET and ground delay programs for flights into New York JFK and LaGuardia until 11:59 PM ET, all because of thunderstorms. Delays at JFK average 74 minutes, up to 180, and at LaGuardia they average 92 minutes, up to 210.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Boston, New York JFK or LaGuardia, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
